Name: Cel's Sheep
Author: Celesty0
Description:
This my first mod and it updates the sprites of the sheep, based on some drawings I've done of sheep in the past.

It includes 4 different sheep colours:

-White (Default)
-Black
-Gold
-Magical (Pink)

In case you don't know how to install this type of mod (it's xnb), you replace the current xnb with the new one and it will update to that sprite set.
I highly suggest copying your current xnb's for the sheep into another area beforehand, in case you want to go back to the default sprites or whatever sprites you had beforehand.

Thank you for checking this out!
